scope: Pure file/JSON/hash addendum; no workload replay, acquisition, process probe or runtime execution

assertions.label: Run repository, ID, attempt and source
Run is completed; whole workflow failure preserved
Exact attempt jobs complete and unique Swift selection
Swift job source, attempt and success
Connector matches raw job and all steps
Artifact created within exact upload step
Successful bounded body and direct child custody
Both pipe EOFs and reader closure
Workflow source bound to prior review

acquisition.scope: new bounded acquisition of existing ordinary CI artifact
limitations: gh internal HTTP events and provider disposal are not separately instrumented
